items.name: error-boundary
items.title: NocoBase Error Boundary
items.description: Reusable render boundaries and NocoBase runtime status views with copyable redacted diagnostics and recovery actions.
items.docs: Uses react-error-boundary for render containment and provides runtime status UI for original NocoBase gateway and account error codes. It contributes only a development showcase at /dev/error-boundary, with no production routes, providers, or menu entries.

items.name: route-surfaces
items.title: NocoBase Route Surfaces
items.description: URL-backed drawer, dialog, and page containers with nested drawer stacking and a shared close lifecycle.
items.docs: Provides presentation containers plus an integrated Demo and Prompt generator. Route definitions, ACL guards, data fetching, and business content remain application-owned.

items.name: client
items.title: NocoBase Client Components
items.description: Small reusable Portal client components with transport-agnostic APIs and shadcn UI composition.
items.docs: Provides dependency-light client components without NocoBase resource or Refine coupling. RemoteSelect delegates data access to a caller-provided loadOptions function and contributes only a development showcase under /dev/client/remote-select.

items.name: users-example
items.title: NocoBase Users Example
items.description: Complete Users resource example with ACL-aware list, filters, route-backed drawers, nested role details, and optional AI page context.
items.docs: Requires the compatible Portal Starter resource components, data table, NocoBase data provider, and ACL provider. AI page-element and form registration is enabled automatically when @nocobase/ai is also installed.

items.name: resource-actions
items.title: NocoBase Resource Actions
items.description: Reusable bulk edit, configured bulk update, and duplicate actions using the core NocoBase collection protocol.
items.docs: Uses core collection get, create, and update actions, so @nocobase/plugin-action-bulk-edit, @nocobase/plugin-action-bulk-update, and @nocobase/plugin-action-duplicate are not required on the server. Collection and field ACL remain authoritative.

items.name: data-visualization
items.title: NocoBase Data Visualization
items.description: Reusable chart queries through charts:queryData with application-owned ECharts rendering.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-data-visualization on the server. It provides the stable chart query adapter, hook, ECharts component, and development demo without copying the UI Builder chart designer.

items.name: record-history
items.title: NocoBase Record History
items.description: Collection and single-record history timeline with field-level before and after values.
items.docs: Requires the commercial @nocobase/plugin-record-history on the server and a configured tracked collection. It reads recordHistories with field changes, users, and optional snapshots.

items.name: map
items.title: NocoBase Map
items.description: AMap and Google Maps rendering for NocoBase point, line, polygon, and circle values.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-map when using server-managed credentials and NocoBase geometry field types. It reads map-configuration:get and does not include the plugin administration page or UI Builder block designer.

items.name: china-region
items.title: NocoBase China Region Field
items.description: Province, city, and area field editor plus read-only rendering backed by chinaRegions:list.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-field-china-region on the server. It lazily loads chinaRegions and returns values compatible with the plugin's chinaRegion association field without copying its Ant Design or UI Builder implementation.

items.name: i18n
items.title: NocoBase i18n
items.description: Optional NocoBase server-language resources, user preference persistence, reusable language controls, and an integrated showcase for the Portal SDK i18n runtime.
items.docs: Requires a compatible Portal SDK i18n and System Settings runtime plus the template's AppExtension Provider/UserMenuItems host fields. The Registry reuses cached systemSettings:get data and calls app:getLang only for registered dynamic namespaces such as lm-collections.

items.name: auth-oidc
items.title: NocoBase OIDC Authentication
items.description: Dynamic OIDC sign-in adapter, headless sign-in hook, and integrated component demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled OIDC authenticator in NocoBase. The default UI is discovered automatically and can be replaced per authentication type or authenticator instance from the application login page.

items.name: auth-saml
items.title: NocoBase SAML Authentication
items.description: Dynamic SAML sign-in adapter, automatic redirect provider, headless hook, and integrated demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled SAML authenticator in NocoBase.

items.name: auth-cas
items.title: NocoBase CAS Authentication
items.description: Dynamic CAS sign-in adapter, headless sign-in hook, and integrated component demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled CAS authenticator in NocoBase.

items.name: auth-ldap
items.title: NocoBase LDAP Authentication
items.description: Dynamic LDAP account/password form, headless sign-in hook, and integrated component demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled LDAP authenticator in NocoBase.

items.name: auth-sms
items.title: NocoBase SMS Authentication
items.description: Dynamic SMS verification-code form, delivery countdown, headless hook, and integrated demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime, an enabled SMS authenticator, and a configured public SMS verifier in NocoBase.

items.name: auth-wecom
items.title: NocoBase WeCom Authentication
items.description: Dynamic WeCom sign-in adapter, browser automatic login, headless hook, and integrated demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled WeCom authenticator in NocoBase.

items.name: auth-dingtalk
items.title: NocoBase DingTalk Authentication
items.description: Dynamic DingTalk sign-in adapter, automatic login, headless hook, and integrated demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled DingTalk authenticator in NocoBase. DingTalk JSAPI is loaded lazily for internal micro-app login.

items.name: ai-runtime
items.title: NocoBase AI Runtime
items.description: NocoBase AI services, providers, transports, controllers, and avatars.

items.name: ai-chat
items.title: NocoBase AI Chat Components
items.description: Reusable NocoBase AI chat window, containers, floating trigger, and employee shortcut.

items.name: ai-react-hook-form
items.title: NocoBase AI React Hook Form Adapter
items.description: Optional React Hook Form adapter for the built-in AI Form filler.

items.name: ai
items.title: NocoBase AI Components and Demo
items.description: Complete NocoBase AI component runtime with application resources, routes, and component showcase pages.
items.docs: This item includes the AI extension integration and Demo pages. It is designed for a compatible starter with the AppExtension host enabled. After installation, client/extensions/nocobase-ai/extension.tsx is discovered automatically and contributes its application resources and routes without AI-specific App.tsx edits.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: NocoBase File Upload
items.description: Controlled shadcn/ui file upload field for NocoBase file collections.
items.docs: Requires a compatible Portal SDK client and a field targeting a file-template collection. The extension contributes a development-only file manager at /dev/files; its public-URL preview gallery does not require attachments:list.

items.name: import
items.title: NocoBase Import
items.description: Reusable XLSX template download and record import action backed by the NocoBase import plugin.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-action-import on the NocoBase server. Business pages explicitly configure writable import columns; the extension contributes a development-only users integration demo.

items.name: import-pro
items.title: NocoBase Import Pro
items.description: Pro import options and async task progress layered on the base NocoBase import integration.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-action-import, @nocobase/plugin-action-import-pro, and @nocobase/plugin-async-task-manager. Reuses the base import Registry item, adds execution mode, workflow, duplicate handling, task progress, and cancellation, and augments the shared /dev/import scenario instead of adding another navigation entry.

items.name: template-print
items.title: NocoBase Template Print
items.description: Reusable template selector and print action backed by the NocoBase template-print plugin.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-action-template-print on the NocoBase server. The extension contributes a development-only integration demo; template management remains in the administration interface.

items.name: mail
items.title: NocoBase Mail
items.description: Mail inbox, compose, detail, and label components backed by the NocoBase mail API.
items.docs: Requires a compatible Portal SDK and a NocoBase server with the mail plugin enabled. The mail API adapter uses the authenticated SDK client.

items.name: in-app-message
items.title: NocoBase In-app Messages
items.description: Portal-native notification bell, unread counts, message inbox, and read-state controls backed by NocoBase notifications.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-notification-manager and @nocobase/plugin-notification-in-app-message on the connected NocoBase application. Exports opt-in notification components and contributes only a development showcase at /dev/in-app-message; no production UI or route is added automatically.

items.name: export
items.title: NocoBase Export
items.description: Portal-native selected and filtered record export with application-owned XLSX columns.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-action-export. Provides column selection, filters, relation paths, download handling, and a users demo.

items.name: export-pro
items.title: NocoBase Export Pro
items.description: Advanced sync, async, and attachment export layered on the base export integration.
items.docs: Requires action-export, action-export-pro, and async-task-manager. Adds processing modes, queued task results, and ZIP attachment export to the shared /dev/export scenario instead of adding another navigation entry.

items.name: collection-tree
items.title: NocoBase Collection Tree
items.description: Server-backed collection-tree queries, ancestor-aware filtering, root pagination, and hierarchy mutations for Portal pages.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-collection-tree and an existing collection created from the tree template. Uses the plugin-specific tree=true list mode; standard mutations rely on server path maintenance and cycle validation. The development demo lets the user select the collection and title field instead of assuming a fixed collection name.

items.name: markdown-vditor
items.title: NocoBase Markdown Vditor
items.description: Controlled Vditor Markdown editing, safe display, and optional NocoBase file upload integration.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-field-markdown-vditor for vditor:check and storage-backed uploads. Editing without upload remains controlled and local.

items.name: password-policy
items.title: NocoBase Password Policy
items.description: Password rules, expiration, lockout security, and locked-user administration.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-password-policy. Expiration notifications also depend on configured notification channels.

items.name: multi-space
items.title: NocoBase Multi-space
items.description: Space context provider, user-menu switcher, space CRUD, and membership management.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-multi-space. Installs global x-spaces/x-spaces-view request headers and reloads after switching context.

items.name: departments
items.title: NocoBase Departments
items.description: Organization hierarchy, members, owners, main departments, and role assignment adapters.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-departments. The UI covers hierarchy, members, and owners; exported APIs also cover main-department and role assignments.

items.name: request-encryption
items.title: NocoBase Request Encryption
items.description: Global Portal SDK query encoding compatible with the request-encryption server middleware.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/plugin-request-encryption. The upstream protocol Base64-encodes query JSON; it is obfuscation, not cryptographic confidentiality.

items.name: acl-ui
items.title: NocoBase ACL UI
items.description: Page, region, field, and role-switching components backed by the Starter's NocoBase accessControlProvider.
items.docs: Requires a compatible NocoBase Starter with the built-in accessControlProvider and ACL store.

items.name: acl
items.title: NocoBase ACL Components and Demo
items.description: Complete ACL composition demo with live role switching, action matrix, multi-collection regions, and field permissions.
